description: Discover open job positions at a company by scraping their careers/jobs pages. Returns job titles, departments, locations, and links. Also detects external job board usage (Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby). Hiring activity is a strong signal of company growth and priorities. No API keys needed.

domain.description: Company website domain (e.g. 'anthropic.com', 'stripe.com'). The tool will try /careers, /jobs, and other common paths.

name: get_job_postings
